Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite notice.
2. In terms of the FIR, the allegations were leveled alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years, was raped by the applicant after alluring her.
It was also stated that she was carrying a pregnancy of 2-1/2 months when the daughter of the informant informed her.
It was also stated that the applicant threatened to keep the victim with him.

In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she was in love for the last three years and physical relations were also formed which was seen by her mother and when, the Anoop @ Abhishek vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: pregnancy
was revealed she wanted the victim to abort the child, which was refused.

She also expressed her desire to marry the applicant and almost similar statement was given under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
3.
The counsel for the applicant has filed supplementary affidavit disclosing that as per Pariwar Register, the victim was major.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that actual age of the victim shall be determined during trial however the statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. do not support the prosecution story, the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 06.07.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Anoop @ Abhishek be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 330 of 2023,
under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Unchahar, District Reebareli, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
